title: Confession of Christ
definition: Confession of Christ is the open acknowledgment that Jesus is Lord and Savior from a heart of faith.
summary: Confession of Christ is the open acknowledgement of Jesus as Lord flowing from genuine faith.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the risen Lord whom believers confess before the world.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Confession of Christ is the open acknowledgment that Jesus is Lord. Scripture connects true faith with a mouth that is willing to identify with Christ, even when doing so costs comfort or approval.

This confession is not empty religious talk. It flows from a heart that has believed the Gospel and now refuses to hide the Savior who has saved it.

Jesus confessed the truth before hostile rulers and went to the cross without shame. Those who belong to Him are called to speak His name with humility, courage, and love.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Hidden faith easily becomes compromised faith. Confession strengthens weak believers, clarifies public allegiance, and protects the Church from reducing salvation to private feelings that never identify with Jesus.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask where fear has made you quiet about Christ. Confess Him clearly in baptism, testimony, worship, daily conversation, and faithful witness, not to perform for people but because He is worthy to be named.
